Whether @Red ` Res correctly captures the strength of full CAQE with failed assumptions remains open. 7 CAQE vs Q-Res: CAQE width and unified decision lists In this section we want to show that CAQECORE is simulated by QNP – Res. While versions of Q-Res (without the NP oracle) underly proof systems for QCDCL [15], the connection between QNP – Res and CAQECORE appears nontrivial. This is why we will make use of decision lists, which represent strategies and even characterise QNP – Res on bounded quantifier alternation [4].
